_comment: vulnagent config - copy to /etc/vulnagent/config.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_scan_certificates: Find X.509 certificate files (and those named in nginx/apache/haproxy/postfix/... configs). The distribution's CA bundle is skipped.
_cert_warning_days: Certificates expiring within this many days are reported as expiring
_os_ecosystem_override: Auto for Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine. For Kali/Raspbian/other derivatives set e.g. Debian:13
_check_backports: Hide OS-managed library findings whose CVE is named in the owning OS package changelog (fix backported by RHEL/Rocky/SUSE/Debian)
_auto_apply: false = 'vulnagent run' only reports. true = it patches according to 'patch' below.

patch._os: none | security (distro security repo only) | vulnerable (security + packages with known CVEs) | all

notify._webhook_url: Slack / Mattermost / Discord / Teams-compatible incoming webhook
notify._report_upload_url: optional: POST the JSON report to a central collector
